scope: v0.26.5 RC7 attempt 38 is the first candidate containing the full corrective pass requested after the RC6 visual/Recomps failures. Build only from frozen production source 669526973fce0a11fe96a3193a0d09c2edfba9e9, which is green on the same exact SHA across Platform Models, Unified Cursor, Performance, Download Refresh and GameCube. Preserve the direct manual Recomps architecture from RC6 and the WPF page-paint correction: selecting Recomps must route directly to RecompsLibrary, Add Recomp Game selects exactly one .exe and appends an independent persistent record, exact saved executables launch directly, removal never deletes game files, stale provider-shell states normalize away, and the packaged behavioral Recomps test must prove the page is actually paintable/nonblank. The platform-model renderer is now HC3D v3 and must not regress to v2: cache vertices are 80 bytes, authored/transformed glTF UVs are stored directly with no hidden V inversion, mirrored transforms repair triangle winding and tangent handedness, and the cache/runtime preserve base-color, metallic/roughness, normal, occlusion and emissive maps, required TEXCOORD sets, sampler wrap modes and KHR_texture_transform data. Textureless authored baseColorFactor materials must render their authored color rather than gray fallback; the GOG built-in model must retain its authored purple material through generated GLB -> HC3D -> real WARP pixels. OPAQUE materials must remain fully opaque even when baseColorFactor alpha is below 1, MASK must discard below cutoff but keep surviving pixels opaque, and only BLEND may be translucent. Preserve single-sided back-face culling, double-sided rendering/back-face normal handling and GPU mip generation. The original user model packs were audited as 36 GLBs / 199 materials, including seven fully textureless models and real base-color, metallic/roughness, normal, occlusion, emissive, multi-UV and transform usage; permanent source gates must continue covering that actual feature set. Generated provider/console models must remain front-facing and opaque; the built-in generator currently produces 50 GLBs and its GOG purple material must remain intact. The full-screen model viewer must use the same HC3D v3/D3D11 surface as the Games shelves rather than the divergent WPF GLB renderer, with packaged HC_GPU_SetShelfItemView / managed SetItemView controls for yaw, pitch, spin and scale plus shared PlatformModelBrightness. Canonical visible naming must use full platform display labels without changing emulator routing identities, including 32X -> Sega 32X, Dreamcast -> Sega Dreamcast, Saturn -> Sega Saturn, Game Gear -> Sega Game Gear, Master System -> Sega Master System, N64 -> Nintendo 64, GameCube -> Nintendo GameCube, Wii/Wii U/Switch and Game Boy family Nintendo prefixes, Vita/PSP/PS4 PlayStation labels, Sega CD, full NES/SNES, and provider branding such as Epic Games, Ubisoft Connect, Xbox PC, Rockstar Games and Amazon Games while Original Xbox hardware remains isolated. Preserve the V7 full-height native D3D11 shelves, persistent GPU asset cache, no bundled GLBs, no distance-based icon reversion, exact x64 host/compiler binaries, unified native cursor, browser/streaming controller behavior, GameCube navigation, download-history/refresh behavior, provider concurrency, artwork persistence, external foreground app behavior, installer rollback/tamper handling, Steam ownership and all frozen PS1/PS2/PS3/emulator-console behavior. The staged platform-model candidate gate must require HC3D v3, direct glTF UV shader paths, base/MR/normal/AO/emissive material paths, OPAQUE semantics, canonical naming including Sega 32X, HC_GPU_SetShelfItemView, the shared D3D11 full-screen viewer, a packaged compiler-generated textureless purple v3 cache with preserved factors, mirrored winding and WARP smoke tests. The staged manual Recomps behavioral gate, active-download stability, Steam owned-library behavior, installer/integrity fault injection, stabilization and final hash verification must also pass. Upload an artifact only if the candidate request parent exactly equals production_source 669526973fce0a11fe96a3193a0d09c2edfba9e9 and every source and packaged gate succeeds.
